18 November 2026 – 5 January 2027
‘Winter Wonder Deals’ – Alipay Spending Rewards
A total of 100,000 Alipay Spending Rewards* are up for grabs this season! Simply scan the designated QR code at participating merchants for a chance to receive a random spending reward worth up to HK$500 or RMB 500, while both local residents and visitors can enjoy exclusive merchant privileges across the city.
Rewards can be used at any merchant displaying the AlipayHK, Alipay or Alipay+ payment acceptance mark.
Stay Tuned
*Offers are not applicable to AlipayHK users and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Terms and Conditions apply.
